This error occurs because **`uv`** (the package manager used by the installer) is failing to link/copy package wheels on the Termux/PRoot virtual filesystem.

### How to fix it:

1. **Force `uv` to use copy mode** and re-run the installer:
   ```bash
   export UV_LINK_MODE=copy
   rm -rf ~/.hermes
   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/install.sh | bash
   ```

2. **If the installer still fails in PRoot**, perform a manual install using standard `pip`:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git ~/.hermes/hermes-agent
   cd ~/.hermes/hermes-agent
   python3 -m venv venv
   source venv/bin/activate
   pip install --upgrade pip
   pip install -e .
   ```
   After installing, add Hermes to your PATH or symlink it:
   ```bash
   ln -sf ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/hermes /usr/local/bin/hermes
   ```
